program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (transform-code grid code)
      (cond [(= code 1) grid]
            [(= code 2) (rotate-cw grid)]
            [(= code 3) (rotate-180 grid)]
            [(= code 4) (transpose grid)]
            [(= code 5) (flip-lr grid)]
            [else (flip-ud grid)]))
    (let* ((token-hits (filter (lambda (cell) (member? (third cell) (list 1 2 3 4))) (grid-cells g)))
           (token (if (empty? token-hits) 1 (third (last token-hits))))
           (cells (filter-cells g (lambda (r c v) (and (not (= v 0)) (not (member? v (list 1 2 3 4)))))))
           (bb (bbox-of-cells cells))
           (crop (subgrid g (first bb) (second bb) (third bb) (fourth bb))))
      (transform-code crop token))))
